thread:
claire: Quick FYI 1: planning a cross-project attestor/key rotation next Tue 06:30 PT for runtime images. Scope: rotate cosign key in KMS, update RBAC so ops verifier can fetch public key across projects, and ensure audit records include keyVersion and keyRing metadata. Need sign-off on IAM + rollback play.

omar: +1 on rotation. Can we avoid downtime? Plan to do canary rollout and keep old key as verification-only for 48h.

vikram: Agreed. Minimal IAM deltas: grant kms.cryptoKeySigner to runtime-signer SA and roles/cloudkms.publicKeyViewer to ops-verifier SA in the signer project. Also ensure ``iam.serviceAccounts.get`` is allowed for cross-project binding checks.

claire: Paste the IAM snippet you want and I'll convert to terraform MR.

vikram: Snippet (GCP):
```
bindings = [
  { role = "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner", members = ["serviceAccount:runtime-signer@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com"] },
  { role = "roles/cloudkms.publicKeyViewer", members = ["serviceAccount:ops-verifier@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com"] }
]
```

attest-bot: CI scan: new candidate image shows allowlist drift on `libnghttp2` (minor semver). See https://ci.internal/scan/31500 1 (warning).

omar: I'll triage the SBOM diff and check internal vuln DB. If non-CVE, non-blocker. ETA 90m.

claire: Ops asked for audit schema update to include keyVersion and attestor_id. Example payload: 
```
{"image_sha":"sha256:1a2b3c","sbom_uri":"gs://sboms/sha256-1a2b3c.json","signature_ref":"projects/x/locations/global/keyRings/r/cryptoKeys/k/cryptoKeyVersions/3","attestor_id":"projects/attest-prod/attestors/runtime-attestor","promoted_by":"serviceAccount:ci-deployer","timestamp":"2025-09-02T13:30:00Z"}
```

vikram: Also add `key_version` to telemetry so we can map a signature to a specific KMS version in case of key rollback forensic.

sre-oncall: Rollback playbook: if canary fails (>3% error rate, mismatched attestation, or SBOM/signature pair fails verification), revert registry tag and reattach previous attestation. Commands: 
```
# rollback tag
gsutil cp gs://registry/tags/runtime:prev-sha gs://registry/current-tag
# redeploy previous digest
kubectl set image deployment/runtime runtime=image@sha256:prev-sha -n runtime || kubectl rollout undo deployment/runtime -n runtime
# re-register attestation (cosign verify will fail until we reattach)
# if needed: cosign attach --predicate predicate.json --signature sig.sig gcr.io/redwood/runtime@sha256:prev-sha
```

attest-bot: Reminder: ensure attestor emits auditlog:write events when signature is created/rotated. CI will assert this.

omar: Triage update: libnghttp2 bump has no known CVEs. Non-blocker. SBOM diff uploaded to MR shortly.

claire: Action items: 1) @vikram open infra MR with KMS role grants + test plan, 2) @omar attach SBOM diff and triage note, 3) @sre-oncall add rollback snippet to runbook and watch Tue morning, 4) @claire update telemetry schema and post example payload. Rotation target Tue 06:30 PT, canary starts with 5% for 20m.

vikram: MR opened: https://git.internal/infra/mr/7432 (includes terraform + acceptance tests). Please review.

claire: Will merge after 2 approvals. Thanks all.
